name: Hydroseeding
summary: Hydroseeding jobs priced from area, seed and mulch rates, tank loads, spray rate, crew and travel.

items.label: Spray hydroseed slurry
items.source: Spray 20,000 sq ft per hour (index.html); per 1,000 sq ft: 4 lb seed x $2.50, 70 lb mulch at $17 per 50-lb bale, $1.50 fertilizer/tackifier, 90 gal water at $6 per 1,000 gal

items.label: Refill and mix extra tank load
items.source: 20 min per refill (index.html); 1,800 gal / 1,500-gal tank = 2 loads, first load included

specialistModels: Rounds slurry to whole tank loads, prices at a per-1,000-sq-ft rate with a $450 minimum and slope premium, and spreads the hydroseeder and fixed cost over the season.
